title: DataStream Data Schema
description: Water Quality Data Schema based on WQX.

MonitoringLocationID.title: Monitoring Location ID
MonitoringLocationID.description: Valid Monitoring ID; required for most Activity Type Codes; Must correspond to Monitoring Locations already in WQX/STORET or entered in Monitoring Locations tab

MonitoringLocationHorizontalAccuracyMeas.title: Activity Horizontal Accuracy Measure
MonitoringLocationHorizontalAccuracyMeas.description: The horizontal measure indicating the relative accuracy of the latitude and longitude coordinates

MonitoringLocationVerticalMeasure.title: Vertical Measure
MonitoringLocationVerticalMeasure.description: The measure of elevation (i.e., the altitude), above or below a reference datum.

MonitoringLocationVerticalAccuracyMeasur.title: Monitoring Location Vertical Accuracy Measure
MonitoringLocationVerticalAccuracyMeasur.description: The relative accuracy of the vertical measure of elevation of ground surface.

MonitoringLocationVerticalCollectionMeth.title: Vertical Collection Method
enum: GPS Carrier Phase Kinematic Relative Position
GPS Carrier Phase Static Relative Position
GPS Code (Pseudo Range) Standard Position (SA Off)
GPS Code (Pseudo Range) Standard Position (SA On)

WellID.title: Well ID
WellID.description: The well identifier assigned by the provincial/territorial well database and/or used in the federal Groundwater Information Network (GIN) database.

AquiferCode.title: Aquifer Code
AquiferCode.description: A code that designates the aquifer or geologic formation from which the groundwater sample was collected. In the absence of mapped/named aquifers, geologic formation names are included.

LithologyType.title: Well Formation Type
enum: Bedrock, Soluble gypsum/dolomite with shale interb

BoreholeDepthMeasure.title: Borehole Depth Measure
BoreholeDepthMeasure.description: Depth below ground surface to the bottom of the hole on completion of drilling.

WellDepthMeasure.title: Well Depth Measure
WellDepthMeasure.description: Depth below ground surface to the bottom of the cased well.

WellOpenIntervalTopMeasure.title: Well Open Interval Top Measure
WellOpenIntervalTopMeasure.description: The upper vertical extent of the open or screened interval in a well measured as a depth from ground surface.

WellOpenIntervalBottomMeasure.title: Well Open Interval Bottom Measure
WellOpenIntervalBottomMeasure.description: The lower vertical extent of the open or screened interval in a well measured as a depth from ground surface.

EventID.title: Event ID
EventID.description: A unique identifier supplied by the data contributor, usually corresponding to field sampling events

ActivityType.title: Activity Type
enum: Quality Control Field Replicate Portable Data Logger
Quality Control Field Sample Equipment Rinsate Blank
Quality Control Sample-Lab Surrogate Control Standard
Quality Control Sample-Lab Surrogate Control Standard Duplicate
Sample-Integrated Horizontal and Vertical Composite Profile

ActivityDepthHeightMeasure.title: Activity Depth/Height Measure
ActivityDepthHeightMeasure.description: The distance from the surface to the point in the water column at which the activity is conducted (depth or height measured from a reference point)

ActivityDepthAltitudeReferencePointMeasu.title: Activity Depth Altitude Reference Point Measure
ActivityDepthAltitudeReferencePointMeasu.description: The height from ground surface to the measurement point.

SampleCondition.title: Sample Condition
enum: Nearby site is being pumped or pumped recently
The site has been recently pumped or purged
The site is being pumped for water use

SampleCollectionMethodName.title: Sample Collection Method Name
SampleCollectionMethodName.description: The title of the method from the method publisher.

SampleCollectionMethodID.title: Sample Collection Method ID
SampleCollectionMethodID.description: The ID number or code assigned by the method publisher.

enum: Benzo[b]fluoranthene, mixt with benzo[j]fluoranthene and benzo[k]fluoranthene

Hydrocarbons, C19-32, Heavy petroleum minus HMW PAH
Ice cover, floating or solid, as % area estimate
Isopimaric Acid mixt. with Palustric Acids
o-Xylene, mixt. with m-xylene and p-xylene
Precipitation 24hr prior to monitoring event amount
Silica gel treated n-hexane extractable material
Snow cover on ice as % area estimate
Sodium adsorption ratio [(Na)/(sq root of 1/2 Ca + Mg)]
Specific UV Absorbance at 254 nm, corrected for Fe
Total Volatile Hydrocarbons C6-C10 minus BTEX
Water level in well, depth from a reference point

ResultValue.title: Result Value
ResultValue.description: Measured value of characteristic, required if Result Detection Condition Text is blank, No entry allowed if Result Detection Condition Text is populated.

ResultDetectionQuantitationLimitMeasure.title: Result Detection/Quantitation Limit Measure
ResultDetectionQuantitationLimitMeasure.description: The reportable measure of the result for the chemical, microbiological or other characteristic being analyzed.  Required if Result Detection Condition is `Not Detected`, `Present Above Quantification Limit`, or `Present Below Quantification Limit`.

ResultComment.title: Result Comment
ResultComment.description: Provided to allow for the entry of comments about result

LaboratoryName.title: Laboratory Name
LaboratoryName.description: Name of Laboratory performing the analysis

LaboratorySampleID.title: Laboratory Sample ID
LaboratorySampleID.description: Unique identifier for the lab sample

allOf.title: CharacteristicName-MethodSpeciation
allOf.description: Certain characteristics, particularly nutrient parameters, require a method speciation (e.g., 'as N', or 'as NO3' for nitrate). This information is related to how the parameter was analyzed. For more guidance regarding how to map nutrient parameters please visit DataStream's [Best Practices Guide for Nutrient Data](https://datastream.org/en-ca/documentation/nutrient-data-guidance).

allOf.title: CharacteristicName-StableIsotope-MethodSpeciation
allOf.description: Isotope MethodSpeciation required for selected CharacteristicName. For guidance, please see [Best Practices for Reporting Isotope Data] (https://datastream.org/en-ca/documentation/isotope-data-guidance)

allOf.title: CharacteristicName-ResultSampleFraction
allOf.description: Certain characteristics require a sample fraction, for example metals (e.g. 'Dissolved' or 'Total') and nutrient parameters (e.g. 'Filtered' or 'Unfiltered'). This information is related to the level of filtration of the sample prior to analysis. For more guidance regarding how to map nutrient parameters please visit DataStream's [Best Practices Guide for Nutrient Data](https://datastream.org/en-ca/documentation/nutrient-data-guidance).

allOf.title: CharacteristicName-Nutrient-ResultSampleFraction
allOf.description: ResultSampleFractions for nutrients should follow guidance in Best Practices Guide for Nutrient Data (see https://datastream.org/en-ca/documentation/nutrient-data-guidance)

allOf.title: ResultDetectionCondition-ResultValue
allOf.description: You may only have ResultValue OR ResultDetectionCondition populated for a single observation.

allOf.title: ResultDetectionCondition-ResultDetectionQuantitationLimit-above-below
allOf.description: When the ResultDetectionCondition is set to 'Below Detection/Quantification Limit' or 'Above Detection/Quantification Limit' for a data point  'ResultDetectionQuantitationLimitMeasure' and  'ResultDetectionQuantitationLimitUnit' should be populated.

allOf.title: ResultDetectionCondition-ResultDetectionQuantitationLimit-not-detect
allOf.description: When ResultDetectionCondition is set to 'Not Detected' this means data was not detected, and 'Detected Not Quantified' means data was not quantified within the defined laboratory reporting limits or method detection limits. For these cases, ResultDetectionQuantitationLimit fields should be left blank.

allOf.title: ActivityType-CTS-ActivityStartTime
allOf.description: Continuous time-series observations must include a valid ActivityStartTime

allOf.title: ActivityType-ResultAnalyticalMethod
allOf.description: If a data point is from a grab sample analyzed in the lab (i.e., ActivityType is 'Sample-Routine') you must provide information on how the sample was analyzed. If you populate the ResultAnalyticalMethodID (e.g. '4500-P'), the ResultAnalyticalMethodContext must also be populated (e.g.  'APHA').  If you do not know the ResultAnalyticalMethodID and ResultAnalyticalMethodContext, you must at least fill in ResultAnalyticalMethodName (e.g. 'Ion Chromatography'). If the analytical methods are unknown, you can also enter 'Undefined' in ResultAnalyticalMethodName. LaboratoryName is also mandatory for all lab-analyzed samples. Once these corrections are made, this error message should be resolved.

allOf.title: ResultUnit-Salinity
allOf.description: ResultUnit that require special unit notation.

allOf.title: ResultDetectionQuantitationLimitUnit-Salinity
allOf.description: ResultDetectionQuantitationLimitUnit that require special unit notation.

allOf.title: CSVInjection
allOf.description: CSV files can trigger injection attacks when opened using spreadsheet software. https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/CSV_Injection. In ETL, `* ` is prepended when fails.

DatasetName.description: OWASP ASVS 5.0: 5.3.11 Verify that the application is protected against CSV and Formula Injection. The application should follow the escaping rules defined in RFC4180 2.6 and 2.7 when exporting CSV files. The application should escape special characters including '=', '+', '-', '@' '	' (tab) and '\00' (null character) using a single quote, if they are the first character in a field, when exporting CSV files and other spreadsheet formats such as xls, xlsx, odf.

allOf.title: MonitoringLocationType-Well-WellUseType
allOf.description: WellUseType is required when MonitoringLocationType contains 'Well' or 'Piezometer'

allOf.title: MonitoringLocationType-Well-SampleCondition
allOf.description: SampleCondition is required when MonitoringLocationType contains 'Well' or 'Piezometer' and ActivityType is NOT 'Field Msr/Obs-Continuous Time Series'

allOf.title: ActivityDepthHeightMeasure-ActivityDepthAltitudeReferencePoint
allOf.description: ActivityDepthAltitudeReferencePoint is required when ActivityDepthHeightMeasure is reported

allOf.title: CharacteristicName-WaterLevel-ActivityDepthAltitudeReferencePoint
allOf.description: ActivityDepthAltitudeReferencePoint is required when CharacteristicName is 'Water level in well, depth from a reference point'

enum: Water level in well, depth from a reference point

allOf.title: CharacteristicName-Depth-ActivityDepthHeightMeasure
allOf.description: When CharacteristicName measures depth/height, the depth is the result itself, so ActivityDepthHeightMeasure/Unit should not be populated.

enum: Water level in well, depth from a reference point

allOf.title: ActivityMediaName-Groundwater-DepthMeasure
allOf.description: At least one depth measure (BoreholeDepthMeasure, WellDepthMeasure, WellOpenIntervalTopMeasure, WellOpenIntervalBottomMeasure, or ActivityDepthHeightMeasure) must be populated when ActivityMediaName is Groundwater or Porewater

allOf.title: GroundwaterFields-ActivityMediaName-Groundwater
allOf.description: ActivityMediaName must be Groundwater or Porewater when any Groundwater-specific field is reported
